lead_raw_text:
The structure of Dy6Ag2 (reduced formula Dy3Ag) crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6_3/mmc (No. 194), with eight atoms per unit cell distributed over two independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Ag centers surrounded by six Dy neighbors, while Dy centers have nine geometric neighbors (three Ag and six Dy). The neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component. Validated polyhedron contacts reveal corner- and edge-sharing between Dy-centered 9-vertex polyhedra, and edge-sharing between Ag-centered 6-vertex and Dy-centered 9-vertex polyhedra.
